description: Filter NDJSON log file by field/value pattern, return top N matching entries.

field.description: JSON field name to filter on (e.g. 'level', 'service')

lineStartPattern.description: Regex that marks new log line start (e.g. "^{") — enables multiline stack trace reconstruction

logFile.description: Absolute path to the NDJSON log file

name: query_log_pattern
